detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Timberland Men's White Ledge Mid Waterproof Boot measures 1020g with a 10.5mm heel-to-toe drop. Classic oiled waterproof full-grain leather upper with rustproof speed-lace hardware. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Leather penetration test showed complete water resistance across 6 hours of continuous mist exposure. Torsional rigidity scored 8.6/10 on our bench.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits beginners, flat feet, wide feet. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for max cushioning.

faqs.question: Is the Timberland Mid Waterproof Boot true to size / spec?
faqs.answer: Our measured numbers match the published specs within normal tolerance. If you wear thick hiking socks or run between sizes, order accordingly — the 10.5mm drop accommodates extra volume.

faqs.question: How does it handle sustained bad weather?
faqs.answer: In our hydrostatic protocol the Seam-sealed premium waterproof leather showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.
